Bharat Ek Khoj—The Discovery of India
A Production of Doordarshan, the Government of India’s Public Service Broadcaster
Episode 1: Bharat Mata Ki Jai (bharat mata ki jay)
With Ravi Jhankal, Vijay Kashyap, Ram Moorti
Aazadi ki laraeeke zamane men pandit nehru ko kaphi samay jel men bitana para. jab bhi ve jel se bahar rahe, unhonne rajnitik janjagran ke silsile men bharat bhar ki saghan yatraen kin. unki har yatra jaise ek khoj thi. bharat ki vividhta bhari sanskriti aur yahan ke logon ne nehru ji ke man par gahra asar dala.
